result:
I've made changes for all five reports. The type check is clean and the existing suite passes (617 tests). I didn't write new tests for these fixes, so the new behaviour hasn't been tried directly.

1. **Comment count:** `countComments` in `src/server/repositories/comment-repository.ts` now counts only comments that haven't been deleted. Replies are counted like any other comment.
2. **Deleted comment in search:** the `comment.deleted` listener in `src/server/services/search-service.ts` was removing a document of kind `"issue"` using the comment's id. It now removes the `"comment"` document, so only that comment leaves search.
3. **Archived issue's comments:** the `issue.archived` listener now also removes every comment of that issue from search, including deleted ones and replies. I added `listCommentIdsForIssue` for this. It is scoped to the workspace and issue, so other issues and workspaces aren't touched.
4. **Rebuild content:** `src/server/jobs/search-reindex-job.ts` no longer includes archived issues. It indexes live projects, live issues, and the live comments on them. A live reply whose parent was deleted is still indexed. I added `listLiveCommentsForIssue` for the comment part. Indexing goes through the existing upsert, so running it more than once doesn't create duplicates.
5. **Rebuild coverage:** the rebuild used to read only the first page of projects and issues. It now follows the page cursor until every project and issue is covered. Comments come from one query per issue, so long discussions are complete.

The rebuild only adds and updates documents. It does not remove stale ones, so a deleted comment already sitting in the index stays there. A rebuild alone won't clean out an index that has drifted that way. I left this out because your description only asks for live content to become searchable again; say if you want a cleanup pass added.
